image_budget.unit: unique photo records; task annotations may be multi-label only after visual review
image_budget.qualification: These are planning quotas, not claims that current datasets can fill them. Holdout groups must be previously unused and independent by route/session/sequence. Reduce training allocation if class coverage cannot fit the holdouts.

calibration.purpose: select confidence thresholds only; no gradient updates

per_class_coverage_targets.important: Coverage targets are minimums for a useful research check; wide confidence intervals or weak domain representation still mean the result is inconclusive.
